		subtract_from_temp_variable = { lr_pw_mid = lr_pw_a }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { lr_pw_mid = lr_pw_b }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_army_attack_factor = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = lr_pw_a }
		multiply_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = 0.06 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pw_army_attack_factor = lr_pw_t }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = lr_pw_b }
		multiply_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = -0.03 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pw_army_attack_factor = lr_pw_t }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_army_defence_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_army_morale_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_army_org_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_industrial_capacity_factory = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_political_power_gain = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = lr_pw_a }
		multiply_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = -0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pw_political_power_gain = lr_pw_t }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = lr_pw_b }
		multiply_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = 0.15 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pw_political_power_gain = lr_pw_t }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_production_speed_buildings_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_research_speed_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_stability_factor = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = lr_pw_mid }
		multiply_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = 0.05 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pw_stability_factor = lr_pw_t }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_war_support_factor = 0 }
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
		# Three months at an extreme: the crisis.
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					check_variable = { LR_pw < 11 }
					check_variable = { LR_pw > 89 }
				}
			}
			add_to_variable = { LR_pw_extreme = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { LR_pw_extreme > 2 } }
				set_variable = { LR_pw_extreme = 0 }
				country_event = { id = lr_power.5 }
			}
		}
		else = { set_variable = { LR_pw_extreme = 0 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = LR_route_red }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_red } } }
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_orleans } }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_orleans }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_bourbon } }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_bourbon }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_communist } }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_communist }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_anarchist } }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_anarchist }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_napoleon } }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_napoleon }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_red } }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_red }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_petain } }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_petain }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_empire } }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_empire }
			}
		
			set_variable = { LR_pw = 50 }
			set_variable = { LR_pw_extreme = 0 }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_red }
		}
		set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = lr_pw_drift min = -4 max = 5 integer = yes }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pw = lr_pw_drift }
		clamp_variable = { var = LR_pw min = 0 max = 100 }
		# How far each side leads, from 0 to 1, and how close to the middle, from 0 to 1.
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_a = 50 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { lr_pw_a = LR_pw }
		divide_temp_variable = { lr_pw_a = 50 }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = lr_pw_a min = 0 max = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_b = LR_pw }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { lr_pw_b = 50 }
		divide_temp_variable = { lr_pw_b = 50 }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = lr_pw_b min = 0 max = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_mid = 1 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { lr_pw_mid = lr_pw_a }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { lr_pw_mid = lr_pw_b }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_army_attack_factor = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = lr_pw_a }
		multiply_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = -0.04 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pw_army_attack_factor = lr_pw_t }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = lr_pw_b }
		multiply_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = 0.06 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pw_army_attack_factor = lr_pw_t }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_army_defence_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_army_morale_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_army_org_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_industrial_capacity_factory = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_political_power_gain = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_production_speed_buildings_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_research_speed_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_stability_factor = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = lr_pw_a }
		multiply_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = 0.06 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pw_stability_factor = lr_pw_t }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = lr_pw_b }
		multiply_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = -0.06 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pw_stability_factor = lr_pw_t }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = lr_pw_mid }
		multiply_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = 0.05 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pw_stability_factor = lr_pw_t }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_war_support_factor = 0 }
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
		# Three months at an extreme: the crisis.
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					check_variable = { LR_pw < 11 }
					check_variable = { LR_pw > 89 }
				}
			}
			add_to_variable = { LR_pw_extreme = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { LR_pw_extreme > 2 } }
				set_variable = { LR_pw_extreme = 0 }
				country_event = { id = lr_power.6 }
			}
		}
		else = { set_variable = { LR_pw_extreme = 0 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = LR_route_petain }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_petain } } }

			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_bourbon } }

		set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = lr_pw_drift min = -4 max = 5 integer = yes }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pw = lr_pw_drift }
		clamp_variable = { var = LR_pw min = 0 max = 100 }
		# How far each side leads, from 0 to 1, and how close to the middle, from 0 to 1.
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_a = 50 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { lr_pw_a = LR_pw }
		divide_temp_variable = { lr_pw_a = 50 }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = lr_pw_a min = 0 max = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_b = LR_pw }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { lr_pw_b = 50 }
		divide_temp_variable = { lr_pw_b = 50 }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = lr_pw_b min = 0 max = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_mid = 1 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { lr_pw_mid = lr_pw_a }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { lr_pw_mid = lr_pw_b }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_army_attack_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_army_defence_factor = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = lr_pw_a }
		multiply_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = 0.08 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pw_army_defence_factor = lr_pw_t }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_army_morale_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_army_org_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_industrial_capacity_factory = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_political_power_gain = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = lr_pw_a }
		multiply_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = -0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pw_political_power_gain = lr_pw_t }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = lr_pw_b }
		multiply_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = 0.15 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pw_political_power_gain = lr_pw_t }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_production_speed_buildings_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_research_speed_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_stability_factor = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = lr_pw_mid }
		multiply_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = 0.05 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pw_stability_factor = lr_pw_t }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_war_support_factor = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = lr_pw_b }
		multiply_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = -0.05 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pw_war_support_factor = lr_pw_t }
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
		# Three months at an extreme: the crisis.
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					check_variable = { LR_pw < 11 }
					check_variable = { LR_pw > 89 }
				}
			}
			add_to_variable = { LR_pw_extreme = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { LR_pw_extreme > 2 } }
				set_variable = { LR_pw_extreme = 0 }
				country_event = { id = lr_power.7 }
			}
		}
		else = { set_variable = { LR_pw_extreme = 0 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = LR_route_empire }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_empire } } }
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_orleans } }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_orleans }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_bourbon } }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_bourbon }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_communist } }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_communist }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_anarchist } }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_anarchist }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_napoleon } }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_napoleon }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_red } }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_red }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_petain } }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_petain }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_empire } }
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_empire }
			}
		
			set_variable = { LR_pw = 50 }
			set_variable = { LR_pw_extreme = 0 }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_empire }
		}
		set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = lr_pw_drift min = -4 max = 5 integer = yes }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pw = lr_pw_drift }
		clamp_variable = { var = LR_pw min = 0 max = 100 }
		# How far each side leads, from 0 to 1, and how close to the middle, from 0 to 1.
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_a = 50 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { lr_pw_a = LR_pw }
		divide_temp_variable = { lr_pw_a = 50 }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = lr_pw_a min = 0 max = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_b = LR_pw }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { lr_pw_b = 50 }
		divide_temp_variable = { lr_pw_b = 50 }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = lr_pw_b min = 0 max = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_mid = 1 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { lr_pw_mid = lr_pw_a }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { lr_pw_mid = lr_pw_b }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_army_attack_factor = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = lr_pw_a }
		multiply_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = 0.06 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pw_army_attack_factor = lr_pw_t }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = lr_pw_b }
		multiply_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = -0.03 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pw_army_attack_factor = lr_pw_t }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_army_defence_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_army_morale_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_army_org_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_industrial_capacity_factory = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_political_power_gain = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = lr_pw_a }
		multiply_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = -0.1 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pw_political_power_gain = lr_pw_t }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = lr_pw_b }
		multiply_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = 0.15 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pw_political_power_gain = lr_pw_t }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_production_speed_buildings_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_research_speed_factor = 0 }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_stability_factor = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = lr_pw_mid }
		multiply_temp_variable = { lr_pw_t = 0.05 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_pw_stability_factor = lr_pw_t }
		set_variable = { LR_pw_war_support_factor = 0 }
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
		# Three months at an extreme: the crisis.
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					check_variable = { LR_pw < 11 }
					check_variable = { LR_pw > 89 }
				}
			}
			add_to_variable = { LR_pw_extreme = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { LR_pw_extreme > 2 } }
				set_variable = { LR_pw_extreme = 0 }
				country_event = { id = lr_power.8 }
			}
		}
		else = { set_variable = { LR_pw_extreme = 0 } }
	}
	# A route without its own struggle carries none.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = LR_route_orleans
					has_country_flag = LR_route_bourbon
					has_country_flag = LR_route_communist
					has_country_flag = LR_route_anarchist
					has_country_flag = LR_route_napoleon
					has_country_flag = LR_route_red
					has_country_flag = LR_route_petain
					has_country_flag = LR_route_empire
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_orleans } }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_orleans }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_bourbon } }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_bourbon }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_communist } }

		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_anarchist } }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_anarchist }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_napoleon } }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_napoleon }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_red } }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_red }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_petain } }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_petain }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_empire } }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_power_empire }
		}
	
	}
